item.stem:
The graph shows afternoon temperature in $^{\circ}$C over five days.

Which two claims are supported by the graph?

options.A: Temperature peaks on Day $3$ at $34^{\circ}$C, and the steepest rise is from Day $1$ to Day $2$.
options.B: Report the word trend as the Day $3$ temperature.
options.C: Temperature falls from Day $3$ to Day $5$.

item.tikz: \begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small,line cap=round,line join=round,x=1.1cm,y=0.18cm]\draw[->] (0,0)--(6.2,0) node[right]{Day};\draw[->] (0,0)--(0,40) node[above]{$^{\circ}$C};\foreach \x in {1,2,3,4,5}{\draw (\x,0.4)--(\x,-0.4) node[below]{\x};}\foreach \y in {10,20,30,40}{\draw (0.08,\y)--(-0.08,\y) node[left]{\y};}\draw[thick] (1,22)--(2,30)--(3,34)--(4,28)--(5,24);\fill (1,22) circle (2pt);\fill (2,30) circle (2pt);\fill (3,34) circle (2pt);\fill (4,28) circle (2pt);\fill (5,24) circle (2pt);\end{tikzpicture}
